description: Can I sell this token? Live buy/sell simulation on Base (honeypot.is) plus trap powers: blacklist, trading switch, pause, tax change, upgradeable proxy; Solana: freeze authority, permanent delegate, transfer fee, hook. Returns is_honeypot, can_sell, verdict (honeypot/high_risk/caution/sellable/unknown), reasons and 24h buys/sells. Query token=<address or mint>, optional chain=base|solana. Price: $0.01 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.
